name: timeline
summary: What happens when and what is stuck: a status finding, status counts, a week-by-week plan with today marked, and a newest-first log.

slots.name: status_finding
slots.says: H1: the status as a finding (what is at risk, what holds)

slots.name: days_left
slots.says: days to the next milestone, e.g. 12 days

slots.name: weeks
slots.says: week labels as a JSON array; inside JSON, write </ as <\/, e.g. ["Week 1","Week 2"]

slots.name: today
slots.says: today as a number: the fractional week index, e.g. 1.4

slots.name: rows
slots.says: workstreams as a JSON array; inside JSON, write </ as <\/: [{"name":"","st":"p|h|f|n","items":[{"from":0,"to":2,"label":"","kind":"p|a"},{"at":2.5,"label":"milestone"}]}]; kind a only for at risk

slots.name: plan_takeaway
slots.says: one line under the plan: what must change

slots.name: entries
slots.says: log as a JSON array; inside JSON, write </ as <\/, newest first: [["time","what happened","done|risk|note","n|p|a"]]

finish_line.says: one H1, and it states the finding
links the tunnel kit, so it renders in every viewer
no stylesheet or script from another host (the kit is ours)
only at-risk work carries the accent
works at 400px wide and in dark mode
anyone signed out who opens the link (mail, a website, an unfurl) can read it only if it was created with visibility "public"; the default is private and they get 404
